metas.name: 1. Homerland
metas.description: A parody of "Homeland". Homer starts to act strangely polite after returning from a nuclear power plant convention, prompting a suspicious Lisa to ask an intense FBI agent named Annie (Kristen Wiig) to help her solve this mystery.

metas.name: 2. Treehouse of Horror XXIV
metas.description: The scariest Simpsons Halloween show yet, featuring an opening by Guillermo Del Toro.

metas.name: 3. Four Regrettings and a Funeral
metas.description: Kent Brockman has decided that local news has been a real mistake and a terrible career move for him.

metas.name: 4. YOLO
metas.description: Marge encourages Homer to cross an item off an old to-do list by inviting an old pen pal to visit; Lisa institutes an honor code at school.

metas.name: 5. Labor Pains
metas.description: When Homer helps a woman give birth in an elevator, he forms an emotional attachment to the baby; cheerleaders for the local professional football team recruit Lisa.

metas.name: 6. The Kid Is All Right
metas.description: Lisa discovers her new best friend is a Republican who is opposing her in the class election.

metas.name: 7. Yellow Subterfuge
metas.description: Principal Skinner promises the students that the best-behaved among them can take a ride in a submarine. When Skinner gives all the kids a clean slate, Bart believes even his own past indiscretions will be forgotten if he doesn’t get into any more trouble. Meanwhile Lisa tries to

metas.name: 8. White Christmas Blues
metas.description: Springfield is inundated with holiday revelers after the nuclear power plant springs a radiation leak, causing snow to fall all over town. When the tourists drive up Christmas shopping prices, Marge opens up the Simpsons' house to boarders.

metas.name: 9. Steal This Episode
metas.description: Homer becomes annoyed with movie theaters, so Bart teaches him how to download movies illegally. Homer is delighted with his discovery of free movies until he's caught for piracy. metas.name: 10. Married to the Blob
metas.description: When Comic Book Guy meets a woman writing an autobiographical manga, he seeks Homer's advice on dating.

metas.name: 11. Specs and the City
metas.description: When Marge tries Homer's new high-tech glasses on, he learns she's seeing a marriage counselor; Bart refuses to buy Nelson a Valentine's Day card.

metas.name: 12. Diggs
metas.description: A recent transfer student named Diggs rescues Bart from a confrontation with bullies.

metas.name: 13. The Man Who Grew Too Much
metas.description: During a research trip, Lisa learns that Sideshow Bob is the chief scientist at a big chemical engineering company; Marge tries to teach a teen church group about healthy sexual practices.

metas.name: 14. The Winter of His Content
metas.description: When Retirement Castle is closed, Marge asks Grampa and two other octogenarians to move in; Nelson befriends Bart after Bart defends him.

metas.name: 15. The War of Art
metas.description: After Lisa's new pet guinea pig destroys the Simpsons' living room art, Marge finds a beautiful painting at the Van Houten's yard sale, which Homer snaps up for 20 bucks

metas.name: 16. You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
metas.description: Homer is recruited as a World Cup referee after Lisa extols his integrity on the youth soccer field in a Springfield Elementary speech contest. But when the Simpsons travel to Brazil (again), Homer finds his honesty tested by one of South America's slickest gangsters in the socce

metas.name: 17. Luca$
metas.description: Lisa dates a competitive eater; Bart benefits from helping convict Snake Jailbird escape from a jam.

metas.name: 18. Days of Future Future
metas.description: Set in the future, Homer has a new clone for every time he dies. Lisa is married to a zombie version of Milhouse, while Bart deals with custody issues with his ex-wife, Jenda. Each defines what love means to them.

metas.name: 19. What to Expect When Bart's Expecting
metas.description: When Bart's voodoo doll spell accidentally makes his teacher pregnant, he becomes a savior to couples hoping to conceive.

metas.name: 20. Brick Like Me
metas.description: Homer wakes up in a Springfield where everyone and everything is made out of Legos, and he must figure his way out before he gets stuck in the plastic world forever.

metas.name: 21. Pay Pal
metas.description: Marge swears off befriending any more couples when Homer offends their charming new British neighbors, but when Lisa declares that she, too, doesn’t need friends, Marge reconsiders.

metas.name: 22. The Yellow Badge of Cowardge
metas.description: Bart feels guilty after he wins the annual "last day of school" race around Springfield Elementary School, with help from Nelson, who beats up the frontrunner, Milhouse. Meanwhile, Homer tries to bring back 4th of July fireworks after they are canceled due to budget cuts.
